title: Unconventional Monetary Policy Transmission and Bank Lending Relationships
eligible_reason: Single policy date. ACC_f x Post_t with Post = months after February 2012 (VLTRO collateral eligibility of ACC-rated loans). There is only one adoption date and treatment is defined by a time-invariant firm group, so there is no staggered adoption. The regression also includes bank-month and industry-quarter fixed effects (non-redundant additional FE) and pre-period covariates interacted with Post.
design_notes: Eq. (2): g_ft = b*(ACC_f x Post_t) + a_f + Lambda_b(f)t + Upsilon_i(f)t + Gamma*(X_f x Post_t) + e_ft, firm-month data, clustered by firm. Eq. (3) is the quarterly event-study version, also single-date. Appendix Table A3 varies the fixed effects and clustering.
estimators_reported: static DiD (single date) with firm, bank-month and industry-quarter FE
screener_notes: Ineligible: single adoption date and extra bank-month/industry-quarter fixed effects. Banque de France credit-registry type data; likely restricted.
